description:
I am a dedicated career counsellor specializing in guiding students through diverse academic and professional pathways. With extensive knowledge across Engineering, MBA, BBA, Medical, Law, B.Com, BCA, Pharmacy, B.Sc, Diploma in Engineering, Nursing, Dental, HSC, MCA, Hotel Management, M.Com, and B.A., I support students in making informed decisions that align with their strengths, passions, and long-term goals.

Whether you're exploring higher education options after HSC, aiming for specialized professional programs, or planning advanced studies like MBA/MCA/M.Com, I provide personalized counselling tailored to your unique aspirations. I assist students in understanding course structures, eligibility, career prospects, college selection, entrance preparation, and future opportunities in each domain.

From technical fields like engineering and computer applications, to thriving sectors like healthcare, law, business, pharmacy, hospitality, and arts — I ensure you receive the right guidance at every step of your academic journey.

Let’s work together to craft a clear and confident path toward your future success! 🌟
